intro: Orwin Gizzmick has just arrived in Feralas and heard that the Gordunni ogres keep interesting minerals buried. Orwin offers a shovel and asks you to head for the Gordunni Outpost, north of Camp Mojache, and dig up twelve samples of Gordunni cobalt, following the blue glow.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I just arrived here in Feralas, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.
If you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. Look for the blue glow, then start digging!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Get on up there and start digging!
I've got places to go and people to see -- time is money!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perfect! I will take these along as I continue my travels, friend. I'm sure I can find someone that will pay a pretty penny for this cobalt.
Here, take this for your trouble.
